title: FGC 613: Clothes Dryers
officialText:
613.1 General.

Clothes dryers shall be tested in accordance with ANSI Z21.5.1/CSA 7.1 or ANSI Z21.5.2/CSA 7.2 and shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.
